semiconductor_relevance: High — Creative Technology Corporation specializes in electrostatic chucks and related components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Creative Technology Corporation, a subsidiary of Japan's Creative Technology, focuses on the research and development of electrostatic chucks (E-CHUCK, ESC) and provides both new and refurbished units. With over 30 years of experience, they also supply aluminum processing and chamber parts, catering primarily to the Taiwanese semiconductor market.
capabilities: Refurbished ESCs from TEL, AMAT, and LAM

regional_presence.Taiwan: The Taiwan service center is located on Gongdao 5th Road, Hsinchu City, primarily serving Taiwan's semiconductor customers.
regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with manufacturing facilities.
